property_summary: After DrugDealer() and one getFreeKilo() from a first user, a second user calls getFreeKilo() twice; on the second call the reference reverts because Kilos[secondUser] != 0, while the buggy contract does not revert and overwrites Kilos[secondUser] = 300, so the final Kilos[secondUser] is 300 in both but the revert status differs.
change_summary: Remove the require that Kilos[msg.sender]==0 so existing users can get free kilos again, increasing their Kilos.
